Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1130277. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort the results by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order. Do not deduplicate rows.
